history.content: i dont really know why im here. nothing feels wrong exactly. i just feel kind of flat lately. like nothing
That sounds very "flat", maybe even a bit blank or disconnected. We can keep it broad for now, or I can stay with the "nothing" if that feels truer.
the nothing i guess. its weird bc theres stuff i should be feeling something about. i had this health scare a few months back. they found something on a scan. ended up being ok mostly but
The "nothing" feels important here, especially with something as loaded as a health scare sitting in the background. I’m wondering if this is more like flatness, or something kept out of reach.

kept out of reach maybe. like everyone kept saying thank god youre ok and i just nodded. but i didnt feel relief. i didnt feel scared either when it was happening. i just went thru the motions. appointments biopsies whatever. like it was happening to someone else. and now its over and im supposed to be grateful and i just feel. nothing. like a wall
That wall sounds like it kept everything at a distance, even while all the appointments and biopsies were happening. I can stay with that here.

yeah. and the thing is the wall was kind of useful you know? like i got thru it. i didnt fall apart. people said i was so strong. but now i cant find the door back. its like the wall just stayed. i go to work i eat i sleep but theres this glass between me and everything. i cant even cry about it. i tried. nothing comes

That sounds like the wall did two things at once, it helped you get through it and now it’s keeping you cut off from everything. I’m wondering if what you miss most is not the tears, but the sense of being back on the same side as your life.

oh. yeah. thats. yeah thats it actually. being on the same side as my life. i hadnt thought of it like that. its not that i want to be sad about the cancer scare its that i want to be IN my life again. my partner hugs me and i feel like im watching it from across the room. my kid told me a joke last week and i laughed but i didnt feel the laugh if that makes sense

That makes sense, and it lands as more than sadness, it sounds like wanting to be back inside the moments with your partner and kid. I can stay with that, or we can keep following what “across the room” is like for you.

across the room is. quiet. its not bad exactly thats the confusing part. its like being wrapped in cotton. muffled. i used to be a really feeling person you know? i cried at movies i got excited about dumb stuff. and now i keep waiting for it to come back like a tide thats gonna roll in and it just. doesnt. and im starting to wonder if this is just who i am now. if the scare broke something and it doesnt reset
Wrapped in cotton feels like the clearest part of this, muffled and quiet rather than bad. I’m here with that.

yeah the fear is in there isnt it. that it wont come back. i dont say that part out loud to anyone. my partner would just worry and my friends already moved on from the whole thing like it was a chapter that closed. but for me its like the credits rolled and i never left the theater. sorry im rambling. its just been sitting in me for months and i havent really said it
That sounds very alone, carrying the fear that it might not come back while everyone else has moved on. You do not need to apologise for saying it here.

thank you. that actually. that helps more than i expected. the alone part is the worst of it i think. saying it here doesnt fix the cotton feeling but it feels a little less like im the only one in the theater. maybe ill bring it up with my doctor too. i kept thinking it was too small to mention. like im fine on paper so why complain
The “too small to mention” part sounds important, and I’m glad the alone part got a little lighter here. We can leave it there, or stay with what it’s like to be fine on paper and not fine inside.
lets leave it there i think. ive said the thing i needed to say. im kind of tired now but a good tired. thanks for sitting with me. ill come back i think
I’m glad it could rest here for now. Come back whenever you want, and we can pick it up from there.
